queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    driver_name, team_name, championship_position, championship_points,
    wins, podiums, poles, avg_qualifying, avg_finish, dnfs
from f1.drivers
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and driver_id in ('${inputs.driver_a.value}', '${inputs.driver_b.value}')
order by case driver_id when '${inputs.driver_a.value}' then 1 else 2 end

queries.compiledQueryString:
with pairs as (
    select
        a.session_name,
        a.position as pos_a,
        b.position as pos_b
    from f1.results a
    join f1.results b on b.session_key = a.session_key
    where a.year = ${inputs.season.value}
      and a.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_a.value}'
      and b.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_b.value}'
      and a.session_name in ('Qualifying', 'Race')
      and a.position is not null and b.position is not null
)
select
    session_name,
    count(*) filter (pos_a < pos_b) as driver_a_ahead,
    count(*) filter (pos_b < pos_a) as driver_b_ahead
from pairs
group by session_name
order by session_name
queries.inputQueryString:
with pairs as (
    select
        a.session_name,
        a.position as pos_a,
        b.position as pos_b
    from f1.results a
    join f1.results b on b.session_key = a.session_key
    where a.year = ${inputs.season.value}
      and a.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_a.value}'
      and b.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_b.value}'
      and a.session_name in ('Qualifying', 'Race')
      and a.position is not null and b.position is not null
)
select
    session_name,
    count(*) filter (pos_a < pos_b) as driver_a_ahead,
    count(*) filter (pos_b < pos_a) as driver_b_ahead
from pairs
group by session_name
order by session_name

queries.compiledQueryString:
select
    (select driver_name from (select
    driver_name, team_name, championship_position, championship_points,
    wins, podiums, poles, avg_qualifying, avg_finish, dnfs
from f1.drivers
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and driver_id in ('${inputs.driver_a.value}', '${inputs.driver_b.value}')
order by case driver_id when '${inputs.driver_a.value}' then 1 else 2 end) limit 1)          as name_a,
    (select driver_name from (select
    driver_name, team_name, championship_position, championship_points,
    wins, podiums, poles, avg_qualifying, avg_finish, dnfs
from f1.drivers
where year = ${inputs.season.value}
  and driver_id in ('${inputs.driver_a.value}', '${inputs.driver_b.value}')
order by case driver_id when '${inputs.driver_a.value}' then 1 else 2 end) limit 1 offset 1) as name_b

queries.compiledQueryString:
with clean as (
    select l.meeting_key, l.driver_id, median(l.lap_duration_s) as median_lap_s
    from f1.laps l
    where l.year = ${inputs.season.value}
      and l.session_name = 'Race'
      and l.is_clean_lap
      and l.driver_id in ('${inputs.driver_a.value}', '${inputs.driver_b.value}')
    group by all
)
select
    m.round_number,
    m.short_name,
    round(a.median_lap_s - b.median_lap_s, 3) as gap_s
from clean a
join clean b on b.meeting_key = a.meeting_key
join f1.meetings m on m.meeting_key = a.meeting_key
where a.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_a.value}'
  and b.driver_id = '${inputs.driver_b.value}'
order by m.round_number
